# Univariate (Per Channel)

- Models: EMForecaster (2025), DLinear (2023), TSMixer (2023), PatchTST (2023), Transformer (2017), LSTM (1997), ARIMA (1970), Persistence
- Datasets: VOIP_MOBILE, VOIP_FIXED
- Grid: L24/O6, L48/O12
- Runs: 960 logs; each cell is a mean over **30** single-channel runs (5-5 seeds each)
- Conformal prediction: on for every run
